_comment: SMART (Substitutable Medical Apps and Reusable Technology) on FHIR app manifest. Served at /.well-known/smart-app-launch.json so the SMART Health IT app gallery and any other FHIR-compliant EHR (Cerner, Epic, Meditech) can discover this app. Customers configure their EHR to invoke the launch_uri below; their EHR will pass an iss + launch parameter and we complete the authorization code flow.
scope: launch openid fhirUser patient/Condition.read patient/MedicationRequest.read patient/AllergyIntolerance.read patient/Observation.read patient/Encounter.read patient/Procedure.read patient/DocumentReference.read
